review_candidates.title: 2027 Hospital Medical Officer - General PGY3+
review_candidates.description: Location:  Bendigo Company:  Bendigo Health Work in an environment that offers:  Support for career progression and development A strong attitude to teaching and learning Excellent clinical exposure across a range of specialties   The Position  Job Reference: 4588 Position Title: Hospital Medical Officer - General Stream (PGY3+) Classification: HM13 - HM20 (Relevant to year of experience) Salary per hour (exc. super): As per award Hours per fortnight: 76 - Full Time / 38 - Part Time Employment Status: Fixed Term (01/02/2027 – 06/02/2028), Full Time or Part Time (job share arrangements can be considered).  Location: Bendigo Health, Swan Hill District Health, Echuca Regional Health, Castlemaine Health Applicants must hold full Australian working rights and meet the requirements for a PGY3+ appointment to be eligible.  Closing date: 11/10/2026   Join a sought-after regional health service and build on your clinical experience in a supportive, diverse and rewarding environment. This 12-month PGY3+ HMO position offers the opportunity to broaden your clinical skills across a range of specialties and regional settings. You will undertake four 13-week rotations, with opportunities available across Bendigo Health and our partner health services. Rotations may include: Emergency Medicine General Medicine General Surgery Mental Health (Psychiatry) Rehabilitation/Geriatric Medicine at Castlemaine Health Emergency Medicine / General Medicine at Swan Hill District Health General Medicine / General Surgery at Echuca Regional Health Intensive Care Medicine (ICU) Part Time Rotation Only Leave Relief Rotations may be undertaken at Bendigo Health or across our partner health services, including Swan Hill District Health, Echuca Regional Health and Castlemaine Health. This provides the opportunity to experience a diverse range of clinical environments and patient populations across the region. Our PGY3+ HMO program offers a supportive training environment, strong clinical supervision and diverse rotation opportunities designed to help doctors consolidate their clinical skills, broaden their experience and prepare for future vocational training pathways. Rotations are subject to service requirements and availability, with every effort made to provide a diverse and rewarding clinical experience.   Working with Bendigo Health Bendigo Health are a leader in regional health care, combining outstanding services with a strong education, training and personal development culture. Created by our community in the 1850s, we have a long, proud history of delivering excellent care to our community. Our organisation is diverse, welcoming and committed to delivering our vision to be a trusted regional healthcare service recognised for delivering exceptional care, being a great place to work, and being deeply connected to our community.  Bendigo Health has around 5000 staff and a catchment area covering a quarter of the size of Victoria. The three main campuses of Bendigo Health are in Bendigo, with many services extended to regional settings including areas such as Mildura, Echuca, Swan Hill, Kyneton and Castlemaine. We offer a fantastic range of benefits for our staff, including:  Staff health and wellbeing programs Career development and education opportunities Generous salary packaging opportunities, to increase your take-home pay each fortnight Flexible Working Arrangements Use of staff gym and pool and access to other fitness facilities through fitness passport program If successful for a position at Bendigo Health you must provide evidence of your full immunisation record as part of the on boarding process.   Your New Division  The Clinical Operations Division encompasses acute, cancer and mental health services. We provide a wide range of general medical, surgical and specialty services including but not limited to; Oncology, Cardiology, Renal, Emergency, Women’s and Children’s, Critical Care, Specialist Clinics, Cancer Clinics and Mental Health Services. Within a state-of-the-art hospital, our Ambulatory and Critical Care, Medical Services, Surgical Services and Women’s and Children’s (including an Early Parenting Centre) areas use the latest technologies to provide excellent care. Our world class Cancer Centre uses a multi-disciplinary, integrated approach to treat specific cancers. The Cancer Centre offers medical oncology, radiation oncology, specialist nurses, clinical trials and cancer research, palliative care, and a Cancer Wellness Program. The Mental Health Service provides psychiatric care and treatment across a large catchment covering the Loddon Mallee region. Family sensitive practice is central to our models of mental health care and best practice ensures the identification, inclusion and support of families, carers and children. Each year our onsite Specialist Clinics provide over 100,000 service events, we also see more than 60,000 people in our Emergency Department and welcome around 1700 babies into the world. The Clinical Operations Division assists with the admission of more than 50,000 patients into the hospital each year.   Bendigo Region Bendigo is one of Victoria’s largest regional cities making it a great city to live and work in. Bendigo provides services for the region’s population of over 320,000 and so the city offers excellent schools, shopping and cultural precincts, sporting facilities and various tertiary facilities. We can offer generous flexible working arrangements - giving you more time to enjoy the fantastic restaurants, beautiful parks, walking trails and wineries within our region.   Interested? We’d love to hear from you! Please ensure that you attach a cover letter and an up-to-date copy of your resume.   Need more information? Please contact jmorecruitment@bendigohealth.org.au for a confidential discussion.     Diversity and Inclusion Bendigo Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and social inclusion and encourage people from a diverse cultural background, people with disabilities and or Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander people to apply.

review_candidates.title: Senior Finance Manager
review_candidates.description: Job : Senior Finance Manager PLEASE READ CAREFULLY UNTIL THE END Location : Fully Remote Employment Type : Full-Time About estaie estaie is building the first global OTA engineered specifically for extended stays, offering negotiated accommodation rates for bookings ranging from 30 to 365 nights. Our model consistently delivers an average of 32% savings to guests while enabling hotels, serviced apartments, and real estate operators to optimise long-stay occupancy, drive predictable revenue, and eliminate inventory inefficiencies. With global mobility surging and long-stay travel emerging as one of the fastest-growing segments in hospitality, estaie is uniquely positioned to capture a structurally underserved market. Incubated at in5 Dubai and scaling across the region, we are engineering a category-defining booking infrastructure for digital nomads, expats, corporates, and long-stay travellers worldwide. As we expand and accelerate our international footprint, disciplined financial leadership becomes foundational. This role is built for a high-performance operator who will anchor our financial systems, investment readiness, and long-term capital strategy. Role Overview The Senior Finance Manager will serve as the financial command centre of estaie—owning day-to-day financial operations, accounting governance, investment documentation, cash flow control, business planning, HR administration, and cross-functional financial execution. This mandate is intentionally broad to reflect the realities of a fast-scaling startup. Beyond operational excellence, the role includes strategic exposure to investors, audits, fundraising, board reporting, and capital planning. The role reports directly to the Founder & CEO. Core Responsibilities Financial Operations & Accounting Leadership Direct all day-to-day accounting workflows with full ownership of bookkeeping accuracy. Configure and operate accounting systems (e.g., Odoo) and maintain a compliant, scalable Chart of Accounts. Lead monthly and annual closing cycles: journal entries, accruals, depreciation, prepaid expenses, and reconciliation workflows. Manage payroll, gratuity calculations, leave accruals, employee accounting, and multi-currency reconciliations. Produce monthly and quarterly financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow). Cashflow Management, Treasury & Collections Act as custodian of liquidity forecasting, burn management, and scenario modelling. Oversee all receivables, payment tracking, and rigorous collections processes across all channels. Strengthen treasury controls, vendor payments, and internal disbursement workflows. VAT, Compliance & Audit Management Own UAE VAT compliance end-to-end, including quarterly VAT filings and regulatory documentation. and later on, Saudi Arabia and Egypt Tax systems. Manage tax-exempt transaction classifications, VAT reconciliations, and supplier/customer compliance validation. Prepare the company for audits, coordinate with auditors, and maintain audit-ready documentation. Investment Management & Investor Relations Maintain and update the cap table, investment records, ESOP structures, and compliance documentation. Prepare investor-ready dashboards, KPIs, financial packs, and performance insight decks. Support fundraising cycles through due diligence management, investor communication materials, and data room oversight. Partner with the CEO on strategic modelling, valuations, and long-term capital planning. Business Planning & Strategic Financial Execution Develop financial models aligned with product roadmap, revenue strategy, and geographic expansion. Advise leadership on pricing optimisation, margin improvement, and financial feasibility of strategic initiatives. Implement financial controls and SOPs that scale with the organisation. HR, Administration & Internal Governance Oversee HR financial processes including payroll, commissions, reimbursements, and contractual documentation. Manage financial elements of partner onboarding, ensuring compliance with corporate and regulatory standards. Implement administrative systems that support operational efficiency and internal governance. Automation, Systems Optimisation & Process Design Implement and optimise automation tools including Odoo, WIO Bank, custom systems and invoicing/reconciliation platforms. Lead process redesign initiatives to eliminate inefficiencies and establish scalable operational infrastructure. Qualifications & Experience Education Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance ACCA, CMA, CPA, or equivalent certification strongly preferred. Fluent English and Arabic are mandatory. Technical Skills Expertise in accounting software, including Odoo Finance, Custom Systems for analytics, and WIO Bank. Strong command of UAE/KSA/EGY VAT regulations and compliance frameworks. Advanced Google Sheets and financial modelling capability. Familiarity with automation tools for invoicing, reconciliation, and workflow optimisation. Professional Experience 10+ years of experience in accounting, finance, VAT, reporting, and AR/AP. Experience in SMEs, high-growth startups, or multinational settings preferred. Proven experience managing financial projections, investment records, and audit processes. Exposure to investor relations or fundraising environments is advantageous. Core Competencies Analytical precision and executive-level financial insight. Deep attention to accuracy and internal control discipline. Proactive problem-solving orientation. Strong communication and stakeholder management capability. Excellent multitasking and time management skills suitable for a fast-paced environment. Personal Attributes High integrity, confidentiality, and trustworthiness. Strong ownership mindset and resilience. Results-driven and strategically oriented. Collaborative yet capable of independent decision-making. Compensation & Benefits Competitive Salary in EGP (Un-taxed) 35 working days of paid vacation annually, with incremental increases every 6 months during the first 2 years. Equity in the company - ESOP with vesting equity ownership immediately upon successful joining. Medical insurance for the employee and immediate family. The company will cover a UAE mobile line. Work within a high-growth, high-ownership environment with significant exposure to the CEO, investors, and strategic decision-making.
